cast: Diego Maradona, Pelé, Dalma Maradona, Daniel Arcucci, Alberto Bigon

name: Doctor Sleep 2019
plot: Still scarred by the trauma he endured as a child at the Overlook Hotel, Dan Torrance faces the ghosts of the past when he meets Abra, a courageous teen who desperately needs his help -- and who possesses a powerful extrasensory ability called the "shine".
cast: Ewan McGregor, Kyliegh Curran, Rebecca Ferguson, Cliff Curtis, Zahn McClarnon

name: Dolemite Is My Name 2019
plot: The story of Rudy Ray Moore, who created the iconic big screen pimp character Dolemite in the 1970s.
cast: Eddie Murphy, Wesley Snipes, Da'Vine Joy Randolph, Keegan-Michael Key, Mike Epps

name: Dragon Quest  Your Story 2019
plot: Luca follows in his father's footsteps to rescue his mother from evil Ladja. Finding the heavenly hero who wields the Zenithian sword is his only hope.
cast: Takeru Satoh, Kasumi Arimura, Haru, Kentaro Sakaguchi, Takayuki Yamada

name: Dying to Tell 2019
plot: In 2012, awarded filmmaker Hernán Zin suffered an accident in Afghanistan that changed his life forever. The traumas he had been accumulating during 20 years of war reporting suddenly imploded. He began suffering depression, loneliness and self-destructive behaviors. Searching for answers of what happened to him, Hernán Zin decided to interview other journalists. He asked them about their traumas, their losses, their fears and their families. DYING TO TELL is the first documentary film ever made about trauma in war reporters. It is a brutal and torn portrait of war, and a tribute to those who risk their lives for the world to be informed.  —Contramedia Films
cast: Hernán Zin

name: Earthquake Bird 2019
plot: Tokyo, Japan, 1989. Lucy Fly, a foreigner who works as a translator, begins a passionate relationship with Teiji, a mysterious man obsessed with photography.
cast: Alicia Vikander, Riley Keough, Naoki Kobayashi, Kiki Sukezane, Yoshiko Sakuma

name: Edoardo Ferrario  Temi Caldi 2019
plot: Italian comedian Edoardo Ferrario riffs on life at 30 and unpacks the peculiarities of global travel, social media and people who like craft beer.
cast: Edoardo Ferrario

name: Eerie 2019
plot: The unexpected and gruesome death of a student threatens the existence of an old Catholic school for girls. Pat Consolacion, the school guidance counselor, involves herself with the students in the hopes of helping them cope, and at the same time uncover the mysteries of the student’s death. Most students suspect of the strict and borderline abusive Mother Alice, who also threatened Pat’s tenure in the school because of her continuous meddling with the case. But Pat’s unusual talents lead her to knowing Eri, a former student who's been watching the whole school for years. Piece by piece, Pat uncovers the secret of the school and the monster that it nurtured for the past century.
cast: Bea Alonzo, Charo Santos-Concio, Maxene Magalona, Jake Cuenca, Gabby Padilla
director: Sheryl Rose M. Andes, Mikhail Red

name: Ek Ladki Ko Dekha Toh Aisa Laga (2019)
plot: Sweety has to contend with her over-enthusiastic family that wants her to get married but the ultimate truth is that her love might not find acceptance in her family and society.
cast: Sonam Kapoor Ahuja, Anil Kapoor, Juhi Chawla Mehta, Rajkummar Rao, Abdul Quadir Amin

name: El Camino  A Breaking Bad Movie 2019
plot: In the wake of his dramatic escape from captivity, Jesse Pinkman must come to terms with his past in order to forge some kind of future.
cast: Aaron Paul, Jesse Plemons, Charles Baker, Matt Jones, Scott MacArthur

name: Eli 2019
plot: A boy named Eli with a rare autoimmune disorder is confined to a special experimental clinic for his treatment. He soon begins experiencing supernatural forces, turning the supposedly safe facility into a haunted prison for him and his fellow patients.
cast: Charlie Shotwell, Lili Taylor, Kelly Reilly, Max Martini, Sadie Sink

name: El Pepe  A Supreme Life 2019
plot: A documentary on the life of Uruguayan politician and former guerrilla fighter José Mujica.
cast: José Mujica, Emir Kusturica

name: El sendero de la anaconda 2019
plot: In the most remote areas of the Amazon rainforest, a writer and his anthropologist friend find communities that have resisted change for centuries.

name: Fadily Camara  La plus drôle de tes copines 2019
plot: Irrepressible French comedian Fadily Camara weaves jokes, vivid characters and physical comedy into a lively stand-up show at La Cigale in Paris.
cast: Fadily Camara

name: Fantastic Fungi 2019
plot: A vivid journey into the mysterious subterranean world of mycelium and its fruit— the mushroom. A story that begins 3.5 billion years ago, fungi makes the soil that supports life, connecting vast systems of roots from plants and trees all over the planet, like an underground Internet.  Through the eyes of renowned mycologist Paul Stamets, professor of forest ecology Suzanne Simard, best selling author Michael Pollan, food naturalist Eugenia Bone and others, we experience the power, beauty and complexity of the fungi kingdom.
cast: Brie Larson, Paul Stamets, Michael Pollan, Roland Griffiths, Andrew Weil

name: Fire in Paradise 2019
plot: In this documentary, survivors recall the catastrophic 2018 Camp Fire, which razed the town of Paradise and became California’s deadliest wildfire.

name: Fist Of Legend 2019
plot: The film tells the story of Chen Zhen when he studies abroad in Japan. With resolve to “learn from enemies to subdue enemies”, he studies industrial technologies here. Faced with continuous provocation from Ninja Chiyo, he, together with Xue Zili, the master of Form-Intention Fist, fights heroically to defend the dignity of China. A battle between Chinese Kung Fu and Japanese Samurai is on, which shows the rich culture as “keeping low-key and modest” in Chinese Kung Fu.
cast: Tiger Xu, Huang Weiting, Xu Shao-Hang, Wang Jiusheng, Wang Hongqian

name: For Sama 2019
plot: A love letter from a young mother to her daughter, the film tells the story of Waad al-Kateab’s life through five years of the uprising in Aleppo, Syria as she falls in love, gets married and gives birth to Sama, all while cataclysmic conflict rises around her.  Her camera captures incredible stories of loss, laughter and survival as Waad wrestles with an impossible choice– whether or not to flee the city to protect her daughter’s life, when leaving means abandoning the struggle for freedom for which she has already sacrificed so much.
cast: Sama Al-Khateab, Hamza Al-Khateab, Waad al-Kateab

name: Fractured 2019
plot: Driving cross-country, Ray and his wife and daughter stop at a highway rest area where his daughter falls and breaks her arm. After a frantic rush to the hospital and a clash with the check-in nurse, Ray is finally able to get her to a doctor. While the wife and daughter go downstairs for an MRI, Ray, exhausted, passes out in a chair in the lobby. Upon waking up, they have no record or knowledge of Ray's family ever being checked in.
cast: Sam Worthington, Lily Rabe, Stephen Tobolowsky, Adjoa Andoh, Lauren Cochrane

name: Francesco de Carlo  Cose di Questo Mondo 2019
plot: Taking to the stage in Milan, Francesco de Carlo opens up about bad habits, religion, politics and what he's learned from travelling the world.
cast: Francesco De Carlo

name: Frankensteins Monsters Monster Frankenstein 2019
plot: When actor David Harbour finds lost footage of his father's disastrous televised stage play of a literary classic, he uncovers shocking family secrets.
cast: David Harbour, Kate Berlant, Alex Ozerov-Meyer, Alfred Molina, Michael Lerner

name: FUKUOKA 2019 (2020)
plot: A bookseller from Seoul travels with a young woman to Fukuoka in Japan to meet a former friend from university. While their reunion is haunted by the conflicts of the past, his travel companion floats through the plot as if moving through a dream.
cast: Kwon Hae-hyo, Yoon Je-moon, Park So-dam, Yuki Yamamoto, Rui Zhao

name: Furie 2019
plot: When a little girl is kidnapped by a trafficking ring, they soon find they messed with the wrong child. Her mother, a notorious former gang leader, is close on their trail and will go to any lengths to bring her child home.
cast: Veronica Ngo, Phan Thanh Nhien, Phạm Anh Khoa, Thanh Hoa, Mai Cat Vi
